description: Rate Limiting & Request Logging Improvements - Fix mismatched applyRateLimit() function arguments, optimize database operations, and implement proper rate limiting for shared IP scenarios like mobile carrier NAT.
steps: Fix applyRateLimit() function signature mismatches between security_middleware.php and upload_clocking_evidence_images.php
Move database table creation logic out of request processing path in security_middleware.php - implement lazy table creation
Add database indexes for rate limiting queries to improve performance under load
Implement tiered rate limiting - separate limits for individual users vs shared IP addresses
Optimize request logging to avoid blocking normal application requests
Add rate limit bypass for whitelisted IP ranges (offices, testing environments)
acceptance_criteria: All applyRateLimit() calls use consistent function signatures across codebase
Database table creation happens once during setup, not during every request
Rate limiting queries execute in under 100ms with proper indexes
Shared IPs (mobile carrier NAT) have higher rate limits than individual IPs
Request logging adds less than 50ms overhead to normal requests
Whitelisted IP ranges can bypass rate limiting for testing/admin access
verification: Test rate limiting function calls work without argument errors
Verify database performance under rate limiting load with concurrent requests
Test shared IP rate limiting with multiple users behind same NAT
Measure request logging overhead with performance profiling
Test rate limit bypass for configured whitelist IP ranges
